Subject: Accessibility & recording release: final registration + captioning plan

Hi team — putting everything in one thread so we can finalize before the event (Dec 3). Key items we need to lock down:

1) Registration fields: we must add an explicit recording/photo release checkbox and an accessibility preferences dropdown (live captions, ASL, transcripts). Please confirm exact field labels. We need these mapped to the ON24 attendee export so BrightEdge can segment post-event.

2) Recording release language: legal want a short permissive clause (opt-in) and a required minimum notice. Ben — can you draft final wording we can use on the form and in the automated confirmation email?

3) Captioning & accessibility vendor: BrightEdge, please confirm whether you want live human captions or automated. If human, we need a budget/quote and a timing window for prep with AV partner.

4) Platform fallback: primary is ON24; fallback to Zoom (stream + record) if the ON24 encoder fails. Simon — can you confirm the RTMP switchover steps and where the recording lives (ON24 hosted vs. Redwood S3)? Add the runbook link below.

Attachments I have: sample BrightEdge historical release (BrightEdge_event_release_2019.pdf). Please review and point out any redlines.

Deliverables by EOD Friday (Nov 20):
- Final checkbox language (Ben)
- Accessibility preferences labels (Marissa)
- Confirmation of captioning vendor & retention window (Laura)
- Run a quick RTMP failover test week of Nov 30 (Simon + AV)

Thanks — Vanessa

Vanessa Ortiz

Thanks Vanessa — got it. Quick responses: 

- Captioning: BrightEdge prefers human captioning for the main session and AI captions for breakout tracks. I've attached our standard release language from prior webinars (BrightEdge_event_release_2019.pdf) for reference.
- Vendor: We have a contract with CXVendor for human captioning; I looped their access email above. They can do live captions and supply an editable transcript within 48 hours. Cost estimate attached (accessibility-captioning-quote.pdf).
- Retention: BrightEdge requests recordings be available for 45 days; can we support 45 days on the hosted player? If not, we'll accept 30 days but want the archive file delivered.

On the registration fields: we need a checkbox that reads: "I consent to be recorded and agree to the recording/photo release for this event. (Required to appear on camera.)" and a second optional checkbox: "I consent to post-event highlights that may include my image or likeness." Also please include an accessibility dropdown with options: "Live human captions, AI captions, ASL interpreter, Transcript only, No preference."

We'll coordinate AV logistics with Simon for the Nov 30 test. Simon — can you confirm time (prefer morning PST) and the RTMP failover steps?

Cheers,

All — draft language and the field mapping below. Kept language concise to avoid scaring registrants off.

Proposed checkboxes (short):
- [Required] "I consent to be recorded. I understand the recording may capture my audio, video, or chat and may be included in post-event highlights."
- [Optional] "I consent to use of my image in post-event marketing materials."

Accessibility dropdown (single-select):
- Live human captions
- AI captions (auto-generated)
- ASL interpreter
- Transcript only (post-event)
- No preference

Field mapping (ON24 export column -> Redwood/Marketing):
- email -> email
- first_name -> first_name
- last_name -> last_name
- recording_release_opt_in -> recording_opt_in (boolean)
- marketing_photo_opt_in -> photo_opt_in (boolean)
- accessibility_pref -> accessibility_opt (string)

Retention & storage: suggested default: ON24 retains the player for 30 days; Redwood to copy raw MP4 to S3 (project: webinars/BRG-2026-11) and grant BrightEdge access for 45-day window. If BrightEdge needs 45 days on the hosted player, we'll need a premium retention flag (small cost).

I've attached the quick CSV mapping sample (registration-field-mapping.csv) with example rows for testing.

Next steps (I'm taking ownership):
- I'll push the field mapping into ON24 test instance today.
- Vanessa — once Marissa signs off on labels I'll update the confirmation email template to include the release summary.
